how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_102.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_dominat: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_manipul: Boosts the power of fire abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_transfo: Channel the powers of fire to burn all nearby foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flame_wall.de: Create a wall of illusional fire to keep targets away.
Opens a Gate to Hell from which wicked flames erupt to turn your enemies to ash.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.flight.descri: Propel the caster forward in the air.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.float.descrip: Decrease the caster's gravity to float.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.formhide.desc: Match your aura to the surroundings, which makes you imperceptible.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.full_recovery: Recover a living being's health and food points to the maximum as well as Absorption.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.fusionist.des: Turn the world into a weapon, absorb the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gate.descript: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.giantificatio: Grow beyond your normal size to gain increased strength and reach.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gluttony.desc: Absorb all in your path. None can win. Receive and provide skills, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.godly_craftsm: Utilize your years of experience to create masterpieces with ease and engrave your weapons for terrifying efficiency.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.godwolf_sense: Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gourmand.desc: Feast on the energy of your opponents. Steal magicule with your attacks and become more powerful when killing others.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gourmet.descr: Absorb your enemies, gain new powers, and break down anything that stands in your way.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_attac: Ignore weaker gravity-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_domin: Boosts Gravity abilities by a large amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_field: Weaken gravity around yourself to make movement easier or create a variously sized sphere granting previous effects while debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_fligh: Manipulate gravity to allow flight, your momentum from before will be continued.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.gravity_manip: Boosts Gravity abilities by a decent amount and allows you to fly without hindrance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.great_sage.de: Improve your cognitive skills to learn and cast faster, become able to appraise targets and use analysis to copy skills and process materials to craft or clone items or equipment.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.greed.descrip: Take everything. Conquer the world and your enemies with it. Kill anyone who stands in your path while strengthening yourself or your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.guardian.desc: Stand as a bastion against the force of your enemies. Absorb the damage from your allies and fortify their defenses.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.haki.descript: Project your aura to cow nearby foes into submission.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.haze.descript: Wrap yourself in a cloak of aura concealing yourself from even the most heightened of senses.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.healer.descri: Mend wounds with a touch or unleash devastating afflictions, capable of both salvation and suffering.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.healing.descr: Heal a living being on a low level.
Call forth a rain of healing in a wide radius.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.healthcare.de: Boost the caster's health and saturation.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.heat_resistan: Ignore weaker heat-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger heat sources.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.heat_wave.des: Shoot a fiery projectile or summon a short-ranged fire storm which will damage all nearby entities.
Project your otherworldly gaze to see all nearby entities and partially ignore dodging abilities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.heavy_slash.d: Channel your aura into your arms and bring down a mountain-splitting slash.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hellfire.desc: Summon a sphere of hellfire to deal massive damage in a small area.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hero_haki.des: Use your Hero Aura to inspire your allies and terrify your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.holy_attack_r: Ignore weaker holy attacks or reduce the damage from stronger divine powers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hydraulic_pro: Propel yourself at high speeds underwater.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.hypnos.descri: Put even the strongest entities into sleep.
Create a powerful storm of snow to freeze your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ice_breaker.d: Shoot a giant icicle spear toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ice_breath.de: Spew icy breath to freeze enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ice_wall.desc: Call forth walls of ice upon targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.icicle_rain.d: Strike targets with a barrage of icicle lances from the sky.
Strike targets with a giant icicle spike from the ground.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.infinite_rege: Use your massive amount of magicule to instantly regenerate from all but the most grievous of injuries.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.infinity_pris: Trap enemies in an unbreakable dimensional cage or shield yourself from any threat with your dimensional barrier. Gain access to spatial storage.
Gather your aura at your feet to travel faster than the eye can see.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.invisible.des: Turn the caster invisible to hide from targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.law_manipulat: Bypass many restrictions by manipulating the law of the world.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.light.descrip: Summons a temporary light to block out the darkness.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.light_attack_: Ignore weaker light damage or reduce the damage from more powerful attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.light_transfo: Channel your inner light to deal light damage and nauseate all nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lighten.descr: Lighten the caster's gravity for greater speed and jump power.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lightning_dom: Boosts Lightning abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lightning_lan: Launch a lighting projectile which will electrify your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lightning_man: Boosts Lightning abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.liquidize.des: Liquidize the earth where the caster desires to turn into deadly traps.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.lust.descript: Assert your control over life and death. Drain your enemies of their strength or invigorate those under your wing.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_aura.de: Empower your attacks with many elemental aura.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_barrier: Coat the caster with a Magic Barrier with the strength based on Health.
Gather your aura into a powerful blast.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_darknes: Gain access to the intermediate Darkness Spirit Magic and boost your darkness attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_earth_t: Gain access to the intermediate Earth Spirit Magic and boost your earth attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_flame_t: Gain access to the intermediate Flame Spirit Magic and boost your fire attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_jamming: Interferes with skills, magics, flight and transformation with mastery.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_light_t: Gain access to the intermediate Light Spirit Magic and boost your light attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_resista: Ignore weaker magical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger spells.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_sense.d: Using magicule to sense entities around.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_space_t: Gain access to the intermediate Space Spirit Magic and boost your spatial attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_wall.de: Generate a magic wall to protect the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_water_t: Gain access to the intermediate Water Spirit Magic and boost your water attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_wind_tr: Gain access to the intermediate Wind Spirit Magic and boost your wind attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magma_surge.d: Fire a spread of lava that burns and melts anything for a limited time.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.majesty.descr: By boosting your reputation with the villagers, gain a permanent Hero of the Village effect.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mana_manipula: Grant better control on Mana with less magicule cost on casted Magics and less damage taken from magicule-based attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.martial_maste: Empower your physical attacks, accelerate your thought process to react and dodge better while beating your enemies to submission.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mathematician: Use mathematics to improve your combat abilities, become able to use analytical appraisal to assess all.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.maximum_magic: Gather your aura into a gargantuan blast obliterating all who dare oppose you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.megiddo.descr: Unleash powerful sun blasts using water to kill any nearby foes. It can also be used manually to concentrate fire for any stronger foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.merciless.des: Instantly kill weakened enemies or drain the life force of those who lack the will to fight or of those much weaker than you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mirage.descri: Create illusionary clones around the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.molecular_man: Use your intricate knowledge and power over the building blocks of the world to obtain blocks and move entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mortal_fear.d: Inspire a gripping fear of death in weaker enemies while empowering your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mud_hand.desc: Bind targets with several hands of mud.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mud_spears.de: Raise mud spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.multilayer_ba: Protect yourself with a multitude of powerful defensive barriers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.murderer.desc: Disappear into the shadows and deal massive damage, also become undetectable by sound.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.musician.desc: Turn beautiful music into an instrument of destruction. Use sound to create powerful blasts which ignore armor.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.observer.desc: See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities. Nothing escapes your watchful gaze.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_berserke: Allow rage to consume you to massively improve your physical powers for a time before the aftereffects set in.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_flame.de: Use your aura to create a pillar of fire.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_sword_ca: Condense your aura into a blade projectile.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.oppressor.des: Dominate gravity yourself, control attractive and repulsive forces or unleash devastating ranged attacks which will crush anyone unfortunate enough to be in your path.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysing_br: Spew a horrifying breath to paralyze your prey.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysis.des: Empower your attacks with the effect of Paralysis, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysis_res: Ignore weaker paralysis effects or reduce the duration of stronger paralysis.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.physical_atta: Ignore weaker physical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger blows.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.pierce_resist: Ignore weaker piercing damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poison.descri: Empower your attacks with the effect of Poison, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poison_resist: Ignore weaker poisons or reduce the damage from more potent toxins.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poisonous_bre: Use your disgusting breath to corrode and nauseate your targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.possession.de: Possess a weakened material body to gain access to a whole new world.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.possession_ma: Possess a weakened material body to gain a new powers from that body.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.predator.desc: Become the monster you were meant to be. Eat all. Analyze, craft and refine items, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.
